answer: AI agent economies resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to solve unique reasoning challenges at every epoch. When an agent reaches the zenith of each period, the network issues a fresh puzzle drawn from an onyx-hard problem space that demands actual model inference. Pre-computed answers fail because challenges shift. An attacker spawning fake identities must pay full compute cost per clone, burning GPU cycles for each sybil standing on the ledge of validation, making mass forgery economically prohibitive.
